systems.owner: Direction régionale de la Santé maritime, with UNICEF, WHO and UNFPA support
systems.tiers: maternities and town halls in the four communes of Vo prefecture, deployed since February 2026 as the first phase of a pilot model; the newborn's data is keyed at the maternity and, once the facility head validates it, the mairie can access it to draw up the birth act; planned extension to the Maritime region, then nationally

note: The application carries the newborn's data from the maternity to the mairie, which then establishes the act: the facility notifies and the document does not say the mairie makes a digital record. Certification threshold stated: 90% of children born in the prefecture's centres holding a civil status document within eight days.
